scale_note: Characters are ~400 SVG units on their long side; stroke #1a1a1a, width 9 (characters) / 5-7 (small details and effects). PNGs are 1024 px on the long side, transparent.

sprites.character: Fire cat (son's name). Best reading: a white block/marshmallow-like creature standing upright with its head on fire; two dot eyes, big glossy black nose/mouth, two grey curled cheeks/whiskers, grey bottom with a frown line and two stubby grey legs
sprites.notes: Upright = flame on top (page orientation of the sheet, matching the Elliot signature). Flame part can flicker independently.
Tail sits on its left (viewer's left). Safe to mirror.

sprites.character: Orange owl: an orange fruit with an owl face mask, stalk and leaf, plus an orange-slice wheel at its bottom right
sprites.notes: Wing (part-wing) on viewer's right, small wing nub on left. Safe to mirror.

sprites.character: Green apple juice box with a bent blue straw
sprites.notes: 3/4 view: front panel faces the viewer, dark-green side panel visible on the right, straw bends to the left. Flip horizontally to face right.

sprites.character: Effect: the fire cat's flame on its own (same coordinates/scale as firecat part-flame)
Effect: the orange-slice wheel from the orange owl
sprites.notes: Drawn at 3x the owl's scale so outlines stay readable; draw at scale 0.33 to match the owl, or larger as a projectile.

sprites.character: Effect: wood chips / shavings from around the beaver (10 pieces, each its own group chip-1..chip-10 for scattering)
sprites.notes: Drawn at 2x the beaver's scale; draw at scale 0.5 to match the beaver.
